resources.string: This canvas has unsaved changes. Save writes them to the original file, then continues this reference.
Save an independent canvas copy and switch to it to continue this reference. The original file is kept. You will choose the map again.
The copy was not fully published. Its recovery data is kept. Continue this same copy; do not create another one.
The copy was saved, but the current canvas changed before it could be adopted. The saved copy is kept. Reopen it to create the reference.
